title: The Adventures of the Thin Man
paragraphs: Frozen collection is mixed: eight Adventures of the Thin Man serial recordings, two Lux Radio Theatre film adaptations, and one 1936 MGM Leo Is On The Air film-promotion recording. These artifact types are modeled separately.

GRH documents the program through Lux / MGM-related artifacts (1936 to 1940), NBC early serial era (July 2, 1941 to December 23, 1942) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], CBS General Foods era (January 8, 1943 to December 26, 1947) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], and 1948 NBC Pabst revival (June 22, 1948 to July 20, 1948) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Claudia Morgan (performer on 8 recordings), Fred Fradkin (music on 8 recordings), Himan Brown (director on 8 recordings and producer on 8 recordings), Dashiell Hammett (creator on 4 recordings), Les Tremayne (performer on 3 recordings), David Gothard (performer on 2 recordings), and Ed Herlihy (announcer on 2 recordings).

The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.4798d1172deaae2c|Armed Forces Radio Service]] (rebroadcast by), [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] (broadcast on network), and [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] (broadcast on network).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include fragmentary Thin Man radio survival, Dashiell Hammett property, Nick and Nora Charles, mystery-comedy detective story, married sleuth partnership, and AFRS/service rebroadcast preservation.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Fragmentary and repackaged Thin Man audio survival, Adventures of the Thin Man network radio run, Lux Radio Theatre Thin Man adaptations, and Publication of Dashiell Hammett’s The Thin Man.

Programs with especially strong personnel connections in the GRH knowledge graph include [[show|inner-sanctum-mysteries|Inner Sanctum Mysteries]] (7 shared credited people), [[show|columbia-workshop|Columbia Workshop]] (4 shared credited people), [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]] (4 shared credited people), [[show|cbs-radio-mystery-theater|CBS Radio Mystery Theater]] (4 shared credited people), and [[show|the-falcon|The Falcon]] (4 shared credited people).
